site: Bank of America Network Security Engineer - Web Proxy, job 26038771, application 140
class: Employer posting entry blocked by final-submission containment
symptom: Runtime stopped at the public employer job description with final submission is only available through the verified gateway or human handoff. No application form had been reached.
root_cause: The public Apply button opens an apply-popup with a same-job Workday link, but the browser guard recognized its label as submission and had no employer-posting predicate. Live DOM showed zero visible inputs/forms/dialogs and a data-bactmln target matching an existing anchor and the current job ID.
why_tests_missed: Posting-navigation guard tests covered ADP and Greenhouse but not an employer disclosure-popup opener pointing to a separate ATS tenant.
fix: Add a click-time predicate under sites/bankofamerica.py and include it in the existing submission guard. Require the exact career host and job-detail path, Apply label, documented popup marker, matching same-job HTTPS Workday tenant target and anchor, and no visible form/dialog/input/iframe. Keep submission and ambiguous controls guarded. During supervision followed the existing public Workday link and resumed runtime; Workday sign-in subsequently rejected the configured login, so application completion is not established.
prevention: Distinguish proven public posting navigation from application submission at click time using portal-owned structure and destination identity. A navigation fix does not establish authenticated access or successful application completion.
